text: Our spring workshop dates are set. We are running four half-day sessions on writing clear documentation: planning a page, writing the first draft, editing for plain language, and keeping docs current after launch. Each session is small, so everyone gets feedback on their own work. Details and sign-up: https://example.com/workshops
